name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
summary: During Hallow's End, Jesper lies sick in Stormwind and longs for treats and fun beyond the orphanage. Too ill to go out, he asks Alliance adventurers to gather sweets for him.

sections.title: A Sheltered Child
sections.body: Jesper lies sick in Stormwind's orphanage in Cathedral Square during Hallow's End. While the children gather sweets across Azeroth, he must stay inside. So he hopes passing adventurers will share the holiday spirit and bring him treats.

sections.title: Tricks for Treats Across the Alliance
sections.body: To bring Jesper the sweets he hopes for, you travel beyond Elwynn Forest. You visit the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then the gnome exile Talvash del Kissel. Each asks you to perform before giving you a treat. You cluck like a chicken, dance, flex, or chug like a train, and earn regional sweets such as Stormwind Nougat and Gnomeregan Gumdrops.

faq.answer: Jesper is a young orphan in the Stormwind orphanage. Sick during Hallow's End, he longs for holiday candy but cannot gather it himself.

faq.q: Why can't Jesper go trick-or-treating himself?
faq.answer: Jesper is sick and must stay inside the orphanage while the rest of the city celebrates Hallow's End.
Jesper asks for four regional sweets: Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mints, Darnassus Marzipan, and Gnomeregan Gumdrops.

faq.q: Where do you obtain the Gnomeregan Gumdrop?
faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel gives out Gnomeregan Gumdrops while staying in Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What tricks do the innkeepers make you perform?
faq.answer: The innkeepers ask you to flex in Stormwind, dance in Darnassus, cluck like a chicken in Ironforge, and make a train noise for Talvash.

faq.q: What does Jesper give you in return for the candy?
faq.answer: After receiving all four holiday candies, Jesper gives you some pumpkin treats he has saved.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Hallow's End brings distant capitals together. You travel from Stormwind's grand streets to Ironforge's mountain halls and Darnassus's boughs to bring joy to an orphaned child.
As a gnome, your home is lost to troggs and radiation. In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel keeps Gnomeregan Gumdrops part of the holiday.
